## 🎯 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix`)

## 🔒 Open-Source Quality Checklist
- [ ] **Zero-Data Compliance:** No user-submitted personal data is transmitted to or stored on remote servers.
- [ ] **Internationalization (i18n):** All new UI strings/numbers use translation dictionary keys (`pt-BR.json` and `en-US.json`) with zero hardcoded text.
- [ ] **Design System:** Strictly follows the Tailwind theme tokens without arbitrary unapproved styling or horizontal separators.
- [ ] **Type Safety:** `npx tsc --noEmit` runs with 0 errors.
- [ ] **Static Build:** `npm run build` succeeds cleanly.
